DPDP-SAFEGUARDS.summary: Protect personal data with reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach.

DPDP-BREACH.summary: On becoming aware of a breach, inform affected persons and the Data Protection Board without delay, and send the Board a detailed report within 72 hours (Rule 7 in force from about May 2027).

DPDP-PURPOSE.summary: Consent is for a specified purpose and limited to the data needed for it.

RBI-CYBER-ACCESS.regulation: RBI (NBFCs - Cybersecurity, Technology: Risk, Resilience and Assurance Framework) Directions 2026
RBI-CYBER-ACCESS.summary: Grant access on business need; supervise, log and review elevated access; risk-based MFA for privileged users of critical systems.

RBI-CYBER-MONITOR.regulation: RBI (NBFCs - Cybersecurity, Technology: Risk, Resilience and Assurance Framework) Directions 2026
RBI-CYBER-MONITOR.summary: Keep audit trails and regularly monitor them and system logs to detect unauthorised activity.

RBI-CYBER-REPORT.regulation: RBI (NBFCs - Cybersecurity, Technology: Risk, Resilience and Assurance Framework) Directions 2026
RBI-CYBER-REPORT.summary: Report cyber incidents to RBI within six hours of detection on the DAKSH platform and notify CERT-In.

RBI-DL-DATA.regulation: RBI (NBFC - Credit Facilities) Directions 2025, Ch. III Digital Lending
RBI-DL-DATA.summary: Borrower data is collected only as needed, with prior explicit consent and an audit trail.

RBI-DL-LSP.regulation: RBI (NBFC - Credit Facilities) Directions 2025, Ch. III Digital Lending
RBI-DL-LSP.summary: The lender remains fully responsible for the acts and omissions of its lending service providers.

RBI-DL-DISBURSAL.regulation: RBI (NBFC - Credit Facilities) Directions 2025, Ch. III Digital Lending
RBI-DL-DISBURSAL.summary: Loans are disbursed into the borrower's own bank account, never to a third-party account, except narrow listed cases.

CERTIN-REPORT.summary: Report cyber incidents listed in Annexure I, including data breach and data leak, to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing them.

CERTIN-LOGS.summary: Keep logs of all ICT systems securely for a rolling 180 days within India.
